name: World Map
description: A client-only top-down world map for Minecraft 26.3 on the Fabric loader. Press M to open a full-screen map of everything the client has seen; drag to pan, scroll to zoom, right-click for a menu that can teleport you or export the view as a PNG, Esc to close and resume. Colours start from the vanilla MapColor palette and go further than a filled map does: grass, leaves and water take their biome's own colour, terrain is lit by a real hillshade instead of three brightness steps, and water is a depth gradient with the sea floor showing through it. If MineColonies is installed it also draws colony borders, huts, names, graves and waypoints; if it is not, the map runs exactly the same without them. No HUD minimap, no server side, no networking.
